objectives: Explain how a small action attaches to a routine
Build a habit that needs little willpower
lesson.simple: How small, repeated actions turn into habits that last without willpower.

blocks.title: Idea 0
blocks.body: In this part we show that a small repeated action becomes a lasting routine when it is attached to something that already happens every day. People who practise it notice that the habit needs less effort each week, which is why the idea is taught first.
